findings.passage: "We already have created a system where you need one of these to do everything almost everybody over the age of 18 is doing," he said. "I don't think it's too much to ask if you are going to vote to have one of these."
findings.note: Quoted by the Indiana Capital Chronicle (Yahoo copy) from his floor remarks in the House debate on SB 10, which would stop students at public institutions from using college IDs as proof of identity at the polls. He held up his driver's license while speaking; the story says non-drivers can also get state ID cards.
